title: 第13章 风灵根特殊筑基第14章 倒卖系统奖励发家致富
slug: 你是来修仙还是来观光的
lines: “有用？有什么用？”
郑常想弄些浮空石，主要是出于好奇，对没见过的东西感兴趣。
虽然这东西能拿来当布阵，可自己也没打算学阵法啊。
“你不是风灵根嘛，筑基的时候除了筑基丹，还能摄入点蕴含风元素的天材地宝辅助，这浮空石就是一种嘛。反正这里有，不妨白嫖一点嘛，省的以后还要花钱买。”
郑常想了想，也是。虽然自己不爱修炼，但有系统灵泉，早晚还是要突破的。
“也好，看到了就捡一点吧。”
“就算捡不到浮空石。捡起一把浮空沙也可以的”敖青提醒道。
“小青啊，这筑基的话，需要多少浮空石啊？”郑常问道。
敖青愣住了，随后开口道：“常哥，我也不太清楚，我出生就是筑基期……”
【宿主，风灵根特殊筑基要完美筑基的话，我这有素材表，浮空石的话，原矿一块就行，普通浮空石视尺寸要十枚到百枚不等，要是用浮空沙的话，至少需要十斤。】
事关修炼，系统都不用郑常提问，就主动回答了。
好好好，看来这系统还是有点用的。
郑常满意的在脑海里点开了系统提供的素材表。
然后他的脸就黑了下来。
表上的材料一页都写不下，有二十种多。系统还贴心的在每种材料后面备注上了价值。
浮空石这一项是最便宜的了，要五十下品灵石。
最贵的一项。风龙鳞，要五十中品灵石，也就是五千下品灵石。
好家伙，自己卖了系统奖励换来的第一桶金才两百下品灵石。
这二十多种材料加起来，得要将近三万下品灵石……
等一下！
郑常看了敖青一眼。
对了，这货是风龙来着。
这二十多种材料加起来，得要将近两万五千下品灵石！
他得卖掉一百二十五个系统任务送的丹炉才能赚到。
乖乖，这哪是修炼啊，这是烧钱啊！
“系统，有没有便宜一点的筑基？”郑常在脑海里问道。
【上品风灵根筑基的话，可以只用十七种材料。】
“太贵了，还有再便宜的吗？”
十七种，就算是选最便宜的也过万了。
【中品需要十一种材料，下品需要要五种，不进行风灵根专属的特殊筑基，普通筑基，服用筑基丹就行。】
【系统还是强烈建议宿主不要普通筑基，就算是下品风灵根特殊筑基，修炼速度是普通筑基的几倍。】
“再说吧，这种事情，要是天上掉馅饼我肯定考虑一下。”郑常敷衍道。
系统也习惯了，没有继续劝了。
她已经做好这次穿越任务没法完成的准备了，就郑常那样，够呛能成仙。
只能看完成度了，完成度过六十，能到炼虚期，自己能拿个实习证明就算了。其他的任务完成率什么的是别想了。
“喂！常哥，你发什么愣呢，快来捡浮空石啊。”
郑常一直和系统在脑海里交流，在敖青看来，郑常就是在发呆。
敖青凑过来，将尾巴卷着的一块透明石头放到了郑常手上。
“你看，这就是浮空石。”
content_en:
"Useful? What's the use?"
Zheng Chang wanted to get some floating stones, mainly out of curiosity and interest in things he had never seen before.
Although this thing can be used as a formation, I have no intention of learning the formation.
"Aren't you a wind spirit root? When building the foundation, in addition to the foundation building pill, you can also take in some heavenly materials and earthly treasures containing the wind element to assist. This floating stone is one of them. Anyway, it is here, so you might as well buy it for free, and save money to buy it later."
Zheng Chang thought about it, and it was the same. Although I don't like to practice, but with the systematic spiritual spring, I will still have a breakthrough sooner or later.
"Okay, just pick some up when you see them."
"Even if you can't pick up the floating stone, you can still pick up a handful of floating sand," Ao Qing reminded.
"Xiao Qing, how many floating stones are needed to build the foundation?" Zheng Chang asked.
Ao Qing was stunned, and then said: "Brother Chang, I don't know very well. I was born in the foundation building period..."
Ah...this...
[Host, if you want to build a perfect foundation with the special foundation of Wind Spirit Root, I have a material list here. For floating stones, one piece of raw ore is enough. Ordinary floating stones range from ten to a hundred depending on the size. If you use floating sand, you will need at least ten kilograms. 】
When it comes to cultivation, the system takes the initiative to answer it without Zheng Chang asking questions.
Okay, okay, it seems that this system is still somewhat useful.
Zheng Chang opened the material list provided by the system in his mind with satisfaction.
Then his face darkened.
The materials on the table could not fit into one page, there were more than twenty kinds. The system also thoughtfully notes the value behind each material.
The floating stone is the cheapest, costing fifty lower grade spiritual stones.
The most expensive item. Wind Dragon Scale requires fifty middle-grade spiritual stones, which is five thousand low-grade spiritual stones.
Good guy, the first pot of gold I got from selling system rewards was only two hundred low-grade spiritual stones.
The total of these more than 20 kinds of materials requires nearly 30,000 low-grade spiritual stones...
Wait a minute!
Zheng Chang glanced at Ao Qing.
By the way, this guy is a Fenglong.
The total of these more than 20 kinds of materials would require nearly 25,000 low-grade spiritual stones!
He had to sell the pill furnaces given by one hundred and twenty-five system missions to make money.
Darling, this is not cultivation, it is just burning money!
"System, is there any cheaper foundation building?" Zheng Chang asked in his mind.
[If you want to build a foundation with high-grade wind spirit roots, you can only use seventeen kinds of materials. 】
"It's too expensive. Is there anything cheaper?"
There are seventeen kinds, even if you choose the cheapest one, it will cost over 10,000.
[The middle grade requires eleven kinds of materials, and the low grade requires five kinds. There is no special foundation building for Wind Spirit Root. For ordinary foundation building, just take the foundation building pill. 】
[The system still strongly recommends that the host does not use ordinary foundation building. Even if it is a special foundation building with low-grade wind spirit roots, the cultivation speed is several times that of ordinary foundation building. 】
"Let's talk about it again. If this kind of thing is pie in the sky, I will definitely consider it." Zheng Chang said perfunctorily.
The system got used to it and stopped trying to persuade me.
She was already prepared that she wouldn't be able to complete this time traveling mission. Just like Zheng Chang, he could become an immortal if he was brave enough.
You can only look at the degree of completion. If you have passed sixty, you can reach the Void Refining Stage, and you can get an internship certificate. Don't think about other task completion rates or anything like that.
"Hey! Brother Chang, why are you in a daze? Come and pick up the floating stones."
Zheng Chang has been communicating with the system in his mind. In Ao Qing's opinion, Zheng Chang is just in a daze.
Ao Qing came over and placed a transparent stone with a curled tail in Zheng Chang's hand.
"Look, this is the floating stone."
title_en: Chapter 13: Fenglinggen’s Special Foundation Building Chapter 14: Reselling System Rewards to Make a Fortune
